name: Animal Testing
overview: Scripture reveals that God has given mankind dominion over all creatures on earth, entrusting us with responsible stewardship (Genesis 1:26, 28). While the commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) underscores the sanctity of life, Proverbs 12:10 highlights the righteous care for animals, showing that compassion toward them is a mark of godliness. Additionally, Jesus teaches that God attentively provides for even the smallest birds (Matthew 6:26; Luke 12:6), reminding us that all creatures are under His sovereign care and that human value surpasses that of animals.
